source_data: BlendedSkillTalk TRAIN, convai2 free-human speaker0 turns only; no seeds, guided turns or held-out messages read for this selection.
source_selection: Top50 by distinct TRAIN turn frequency after explicit source-only prioritization exclusions. Selection frozen before looking up or authoring any targets.
normalization: Casefold, whitespace collapse, curly apostrophe→straight; outer sentence punctuation/quotes removed for frequency keys only. Native matching policy is not yet approved.
unit_scope: Complete1–5-word utterances or punctuation-delimited sentence clauses. No arbitrary substring/minus-one-word search and no free slots.

exclusions.lol: Laughter/nonlexical marker; not prioritized in this first conversational-unit arm.
exclusions.nice: Bare adjective with approval/descriptive ambiguity; prefer complete evaluative clauses.
exclusions.i do: Predicate ellipsis depends on previous turn.
exclusions.you: Bare pronoun with incomplete pragmatic intent.
exclusions.what do you do: Occupation versus current-action question needs a separate sense choice.
exclusions.awesome: Bare evaluative adjective; prefer complete evaluative clauses.
exclusions.oh: Bare reaction; prefer more explicit discourse function.
exclusions.yes i do: Predicate ellipsis depends on previous turn.
exclusions.it is: Predicate ellipsis depends on previous turn.
exclusions.do you: Predicate ellipsis depends on previous turn.
exclusions.good: Bare adjective with multiple discourse roles.
exclusions.what: Bare question can request repetition or object identification.

limitations: Frequency reach is a training inventory upper bound, not target correctness or native coverage.
Corpus is crowdsourced persona conversation, not population-weighted WhatsApp/customer traffic.
Some complete units still have discourse-sense risks (e.g. I see, really, approval vs literal cool). Those remain target-review questions, not implicit acceptance.
Grouping organizes related senses/variants; no variant automatically inherits another target.
The50units do not claim90% conversational coverage or solve learned-word progression.
Previously evaluated sources must not be reused as new blind proof of these units.
